scholarships.name: San Rafael Municipal Scholarship (Bulacan)
scholarships.requirements: San Rafael resident, good academic standing

scholarships.name: San Ildefonso Municipal Scholarship (Bulacan)
scholarships.requirements: San Ildefonso resident, good academic standing

scholarships.name: Indang Municipal Scholarship (Cavite)
scholarships.applicantNotes: Apply at MSWDO. Home of CavSU main campus.

scholarships.name: Santa Maria Municipal Scholarship (Laguna)
scholarships.requirements: Santa Maria Laguna resident, good academic standing
scholarships.verificationSource: Santa Maria Laguna Municipal Government page

scholarships.name: Victoria Municipal Scholarship (Laguna)
scholarships.requirements: Victoria Laguna resident, good academic standing

scholarships.name: Pila Municipal Scholarship (Laguna)
scholarships.requirements: Pila Laguna resident, good academic standing

scholarships.name: Paete Municipal Scholarship (Laguna)
scholarships.applicantNotes: Paete is famous for woodcarving; some LGU arts grants may apply.

scholarships.name: San Mateo Municipal Scholarship (Rizal)
scholarships.requirements: San Mateo Rizal resident, good academic standing
scholarships.verificationSource: San Mateo Rizal Municipal Government page

scholarships.provider: Municipal Government of General Mariano Alvarez
scholarships.name: GMA Municipal Scholarship (Cavite)
scholarships.eligibility: Residents of Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Cavite

scholarships.name: Smart Wireless Engineering Education Program (SWEEP)
scholarships.eligibility: College students enrolled in ECE, IT, or CS in partner universities
scholarships.benefits: Access to Smart network equipment for thesis/projects, training, potential employment
scholarships.coverage: Training and equipment access (not direct tuition subsidy)
scholarships.requirements: 3rd or 4th year student in partner school, team-based project proposal
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Usually accepts project proposals in the 1st semester
scholarships.applicantNotes: Not a traditional cash scholarship, but an invaluable industry partnership program for engineering/IT students.

scholarships.name: EEI Corporation Engineering Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Engineering students (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical) from low-income families
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, monthly allowance, guaranteed job offer after passing the board exam
scholarships.requirements: Filipino citizen, engineering student, passing grades, financial need
scholarships.location: National (Study anywhere, based in QC/Rizal for work)
scholarships.verificationSource: EEI Corporation official website CSR section
scholarships.applicantNotes: One of the best construction industry scholarships in the PH. Requires a return service to work for EEI.

scholarships.name: URC Scholarship Program
scholarships.eligibility: Dependents of URC employees and external students in food tech, engineering, or business
scholarships.requirements: Good academic standing, enrolled in aligned programs
scholarships.applicantNotes: Priority to food science and engineering aligned with URC's FMCG manufacturing.

scholarships.name: Monde Nissin Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Students in Food Technology, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, and Industrial Engineering
scholarships.requirements: Enrolled in specific programs, good academic standing
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Check with partner universities or Monde Nissin HR
scholarships.applicantNotes: Highly specialized for FMCG manufacturing and R&D.

scholarships.provider: Federation of Filipino-Chinese Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FFCCCII)
scholarships.name: FFCCCII Scholarship Program
scholarships.eligibility: Filipino-Chinese students or financially deserving students recommended by member chambers
scholarships.requirements: Good moral character, financial need, endorsement by local Filipino-Chinese chamber
scholarships.applicantNotes: Requires coordination with local Filipino-Chinese chambers of commerce.

scholarships.name: Zonta Club Pampanga Women's Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Female college students in Pampanga demonstrating leadership and academic potential
scholarships.requirements: Female, Pampanga resident, good academic standing
scholarships.applicantNotes: Zonta focuses on empowering women. Application process is usually direct to the club.

scholarships.name: PESO-LGU TESDA Scholarship (Special Programs for Employments of Students / SPES)
scholarships.eligibility: Poor but deserving students aged 15-30, currently enrolled or planning to enroll in TVET
scholarships.benefits: Training costs covered, daily wage during internship (60% from DOLE, 40% from employer)
scholarships.requirements: Registered with local PESO, 15-30 years old, parents' combined income not exceeding poverty threshold
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Rolling basis, usually summer or before semesters
scholarships.applicantNotes: Joint program of DOLE and LGUs. Not just for college; heavily used for TVET. Apply at your local barangay or city PESO office.

scholarships.name: Converge ICT Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Students in ECE, IT, CS, and Computer Engineering
scholarships.requirements: Good academic standing, enrolled in partner schools or highly qualified
scholarships.applicantNotes: A relatively new telco player, Converge is starting to build its talent pipeline through academe partnerships.

scholarships.name: Emperador Scholarship Program
scholarships.eligibility: Students in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Business
scholarships.location: National (HQ in Metro Manila, distilleries in Luzon/VisMin)
scholarships.applicantNotes: World's largest brandy producer. Highly aligned with chemistry and industrial engineering.

scholarships.name: NutriAsia Scholarship Program
scholarships.eligibility: Students in Food Technology, Industrial Engineering, and Supply Chain Management
scholarships.requirements: Good academic standing, enrolled in related programs
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Check with partner schools or NutriAsia HR
scholarships.verificationSource: NutriAsia corporate social media and CSR posts
scholarships.applicantNotes: Maker of Silver Swan, Datu Puti, etc. Priority given to students near their manufacturing facilities.

scholarships.name: MPIC / Pangilinan Group Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Dependents of MPIC group company employees and external scholars in medicine, engineering, and business
scholarships.requirements: Good academic standing, financial need (for external)
scholarships.applicantNotes: Covers subsidiaries like Maynilad, Meralco, Tollways, and hospitals.

scholarships.name: D&L Industries Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Students in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, and Packaging Engineering
scholarships.benefits: Tuition assistance, internship at D&L Polymers or Chemplas
scholarships.requirements: Enrolled in aligned programs, good academic standing
scholarships.location: National (HQ in Quezon City, plants in Laguna/Batangas)
scholarships.applicantNotes: Leading plastic and chemical manufacturer in PH. Very niche but high-value for ChemEng/Chemistry students.

scholarships.name: Holcim Philippines Engineering Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Students in Civil Engineering and Materials Engineering
scholarships.requirements: CE or ME student, good academic standing
scholarships.location: National (Plants in Bulacan, Laguna, Misamis Oriental)
scholarships.applicantNotes: One of the leading cement companies. Perfect match for Civil and Materials engineering students.

scholarships.name: Meralco Educational Assistance for Dependents
scholarships.benefits: Tuition reimbursement or subsidy based on employee tenure
scholarships.requirements: Child/dependent of Meralco employee, good academic standing
scholarships.location: Meralco franchise area (NCR, Bulacan, Rizal, Laguna, Cavite, Pampanga)
scholarships.verificationSource: Meralco employee intranet and HR policies (publicly known benefit)
scholarships.applicantNotes: Not open to the general public. Listed for awareness as many families in the scope region are Meralco dependents.

scholarships.name: PLDT Educational Assistance for Dependents
scholarships.benefits: Tuition subsidy based on employee tenure and grade
scholarships.requirements: Child/dependent of PLDT employee, good academic standing
scholarships.applicantNotes: Not open to the general public.

scholarships.name: Manila Water Dependents Scholarship
scholarships.requirements: Child/dependent of Manila Water employee, good academic standing
scholarships.applicantNotes: Not open to the general public. Often distinct from the Manila Water Foundation external scholarship.

scholarships.name: PAREF Financial Aid Program
scholarships.eligibility: Students accepted in PAREF schools (Southridge, Woodrose, Rosemont, etc.) who need financial help
scholarships.requirements: Must pass PAREF school admission, family financial assessment
scholarships.applicantNotes: Strong value-formation based financial aid. Requires active parent involvement.

scholarships.name: PAM-DOLE Industry Scholarship (Joint)
scholarships.eligibility: Students taking up engineering and manufacturing-related courses
scholarships.verificationSource: PAM website (limited public info on specific current scholarship)
scholarships.applicantNotes: Status unknown — many industry associations shifted to TESDA TWSP/SPES models. Verify with DOLE or PAM.

scholarships.name: Oblate Scholarship Foundation (For Notre Dame schools, but some national slots)
scholarships.eligibility: Deserving students, priority to those from poor communities
scholarships.location: National (Primarily Mindanao, but some slots in Luzon partner schools)
scholarships.applicantNotes: Included for breadth, though primarily focused on Mindanao. May have limited applicability to target regions.

scholarships.name: DOST Capacity Building Program for S&T Scholars (CARSE)
scholarships.eligibility: Active DOST-SEI scholars needing additional support (research, thesis, conferences)
scholarships.benefits: Funding for research, thesis, or conference attendance
scholarships.requirements: Must be an active DOST-SEI undergraduate or graduate scholar
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Rolling basis, call for proposals periodically
scholarships.applicantNotes: Not for tuition; this is for capacity building (thesis funding, lab equipment, travel grants) for existing DOST scholars.

scholarships.name: DTI Youth Entrepreneurship Program (YEP) / Negosyo Center Support
scholarships.eligibility: College students or out-of-school youth with business ideas
scholarships.benefits: Business training, mentoring, access to financing (not traditional scholarship)
scholarships.requirements: Business idea, willingness to attend DTI workshops
scholarships.applicantNotes: Not an educational scholarship, but critical financial/business support for EA (Enterprising) RIASEC types who want to start a business instead of traditional employment.
